newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London make modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London make modest gains.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London struggled to go higher on Tuesday but a firm opening on Wall Street stimulated buying interest, dealers said.
Shares in HSBC picked up after drifting down to about $HK 256 and they managed to recoup most of the loss by closing down 0.5 to $HK 258.
Other stocks to improve during the day were Cheung Kong (Holdings), China Light & Power and Hutchison Whampoa.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index registered a gain of 6.90 points to 15,453.68 after slipping to 15,389.42.
